summary: OneMedNet Corp filed an 8-K disclosing a standby equity purchase agreement with YA II PN, Ltd. (Yorkville) allowing the company to sell up to $25M of common stock at 97% of market price over 36 months. Each advance is capped at greater of 500K shares or 100% of 5-day average daily volume. Yorkville is limited to 4.99% beneficial ownership and a 19.99% exchange cap unless shareholder approval is obtained. This is an equity line facility providing flexible capital access. Watch for registration statement effectiveness and utilization pace for potential dilution.
